parts.label: (ii)
parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$P = 21600 - 8000 \text{ W}$; $\text{DF} = \dfrac{21600 - 8000}{30} \left[= \dfrac{13600}{30} = 453.333..\right]$ B1 FT (Follow through on their power from 5(a)(i); Allow Driving Force (DF) $= \dfrac{8000}{30} = 266.7$ as the force due to solely to the change in power provided correct equation(s) used.)
Car: $\text{DF} - 440 - T = 1250a$; Caravan: $T - 280 = 800a$; System: $\text{DF} - (440 + 280) = 2050a$ M1 (Apply Newton's 2nd law to either the car or to the caravan or to the system.
